name: Bambu Lab A1 mini, stock 0.4 mm hotend: what hangs around the nozzle tip
frame: +x right, +y rear, h = height above the nozzle tip, all mm. Material higher than tip + h at that offset is hit.
tags: M measured on a real hotend by others, C CAD / official profile, E estimate. Nothing here is Spark's own measurement yet.
source: fich-l/orcaslicer-nonplanar NonplanarClearanceModel (developed and test-printed on an A1 mini, Oct 2026: 12 deg and a 5 mm span print, 15 deg rubs); Bambu Studio 'Bambu Lab A1 mini 0.4 nozzle' machine profile (nozzle_height 4.76, rod 25 mm up). Read 22 Nov 2026.

nozzle.note: M: tip flat 1.10 across; the bare nozzle widens to 3.2 across at 2.5 mm up, where the heater block starts (the official 4.76 mm is not used: 2.5 is the safer number)

block.note: M: heater block and sock underside

flank.note: M-derived: everything outside the block clears a 12 deg rise from the block edge, up to 7.5 mm; fan ducts, cover and cutter sit above that surface

ceiling.note: C: nothing printed in the same layer may stand more than 7.5 mm over the tip anywhere under the head (radius 73); the X arm is 25 mm up

limits.note: design slope 10 deg, never over 12 (15 rubbed on a real A1 mini); curved relief in one layer at most 5 mm (printed by others); layer thickness kept inside the 0.4 nozzle's 0.08-0.28; bent moves at most 50 mm/s and 12 mm/s in Z (machine: 30 mm/s, 1500 mm/s2, jerk 5)
